items.name: Anmol
items.quote: It was great doing business with Pratik bhaiya. Loved the range, prices, easy billing and payment methods. No doubt, a great place to buy bangles.

items.name: Bhavesh Dixit
items.quote: Best variety of bangles available here with very standard rates. A great business policy and goods delivered to your doorstep by transport.

items.name: Nappu
items.quote: A great experience with a lovely range of bangles and helpful service.

items.name: Customer
items.quote: The shop owner is very frank. Prices are good and the finishing of the bangles is also good.

items.name: Harprit Singh
items.quote: Very organised business system. I am impressed by the way they deal with customers. Variety and rates are good.

items.name: Sachet Verma
items.quote: Best experience. Excellent quality and excellent staff work.

about.title: Our Story
about.description: A legacy of jewellery and trust since 1977.

sections.title: Inspired by tradition. Built on trust.
sections.description: Established in 1977, Arbuda Bangles brings together traditional craftsmanship, vibrant colour and dependable service. We are exporters, suppliers and traders of bangles and kadas.
